entries.title: Show HN: HackerNewsers,com, find other hackers near you
entries.author: phpnode
entries.current_title: Show HN: HackerNewsers,com, find other hackers near you
entries.excerpt: There's been lots of discussion recently about finding other HNers to talk to / bounce ideas off / work with, some Google spreadsheets were set up to share details but they were soon vandalised. I had a spare afternoon yesterday (which turned into a long day) and here's the result: http://www.hackernewsers.com/ It's only open to people with HN accounts, it lets you post your biography, location, skills etc. Anyway, I hope you like it and find it useful.
entries.guide_zh: HackerNewsers 帮助寻找附近的 HN 用户，让线上讨论延伸到本地交流。

entries.title: Show HN: Created a Job Board for Remote Programming Jobs
entries.author: AmberShah
entries.current_title: Show HN: Created a Job Board for Remote Programming Jobs
entries.excerpt: Based on the multiple "Who's hiring remotely?" and similar posts on HN, I thought it might be useful to have a site that aggregates remote programming jobs. There is way too much spam out and an inconsistent way to say "work from home" so traditional searching doesn't work (or rather, takes a long time per person). I've worked in a few remote programming positions so I figured I might know of some companies or searching tricks to find them. Let me know if you'd find this type
entries.guide_zh: 针对社区反复出现的需求，作者创建专门发布远程编程岗位的招聘站。

entries.title: Show HN: http://hackerbra.in - fast and smart hacker news
entries.author: adrianwaj
entries.current_title: Show HN: http://hackerbra.in - fast and smart hacker news
entries.excerpt: I've finally launched a site that helps me check out Hacker News, as an adaptation to changes in the way I use Hacker News. http://hackerbra.in This site helps me get a quick view of current and historic Home, Ask and Best pages. Its specialty lies in: 1) the ability to open up only top comments for any item, inline without page reload. 2) the ability to see a user profile without requiring page reload.
entries.guide_zh: hackerbra.in 根据作者阅读习惯重新组织 HN，尝试更快地浏览社区内容。
